visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, dressed in a gray short-sleeved crop top and a black mini-skirt, stands on a rocky seaside embankment under a bright, cloudless blue sky. She points excitedly towards the horizon, her facial expression cheerful and relaxed. (2) The camera moves to a tight close-up of her face, revealing skin that is noticeably damp with sweat and makeup that appears smudged and uneven. She glances upward with a strained, uncomfortable expression, her mouth slightly downturned in annoyance at the heat. (3) Walking along a paved seaside promenade, the woman’s hair is visibly matted and sticking to the sides of her neck and forehead. She reaches up with her right hand to pull the damp strands away from her skin, looking weary and frustrated. (4) Standing in a lush green field with tall grass and white wind turbines in the distant background, she presents several bottles of Nivea deodorant on a low stone wall. She gestures with open palms towards the products, her expression now bright and enthusiastic. (5) The scene shifts to a bathroom with white wall tiles where she wears a white camisole and a towel around her head. She holds a Nivea roll-on bottle, unscrews the cap, and applies it to her underarm with a focused, satisfied smile. (6) In a final outdoor sequence by the coast, she wears a white lace top and a wide-brimmed straw hat. She raises both arms high towards the sky, spinning around to show her dry underarms and brightened skin, radiating confidence and joy.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody characterized by clear, resonant strings and a steady percussion beat. A female voice speaks with a friendly, high-pitched tone, followed by a male voice that sounds playful and slightly teasing as they interact. (2) A sudden, loud percussive "thud" sound effect cuts the music briefly, marking a transition to a more dramatic atmosphere. The female voice drops in pitch and slows her speech rate to express exaggerated physical discomfort, accompanied by the sound of fabric rustling. (3) A sharp "whoosh" sound effect leads into the main promotional section where the BGM swells in volume and energy. The female narrator’s voice shifts to a professional, clear broadcasting style with high articulation clarity and an enthusiastic, rising intonation pattern. (4) Multiple digital "ding" and "sparkle" sound effects are layered over the speech as specific product benefits are mentioned. These high-frequency transients are crisp and prominent in the mix, contrasting with the warm acoustic texture of the background music. (5) The final phase features a blend of the female voice laughing and shouting with high arousal over a triumphant musical peak. The guitar and drums maintain a driving rhythm, while the overall spectral brightness remains high, concluding with a clean fade-out of the music.
